sources.source_date: Not stated in layer metadata snapshot
sources.source_crs: Query geometry EPSG:4326; layer metadata WKID 102100/latestWkid 3857
sources.measurement_method: Use all 24 non-closure vertices; transform lon/lat to the approximate campus meters using the conversion specified in modular/AGENTS.md. No rotation or scale adjustment was applied.
sources.uncertainty: GIS geometry is an identified building polygon, not a surveyed wall line. GIS vertical attributes have undocumented semantics. The Shape__Area field is calculated in the layer spatial reference EPSG:3857; reprojecting the EPSG:4326 query ring to EPSG:3857 yields approximately 5889.32 m2, matching the published 5889.3203 m2 field. The smaller 3407.26 m2 area is in approximate ground coordinates and is a CRS-dependent value, not a source conflict. Shape__Length field units/semantics remain undocumented.

footprint.transform_note: Approximate local campus conversion from modular/AGENTS.md; not a surveyed CRS.
footprint.orientation: GIS vertex order retained without rotation; long footprint axis is approximately north-south.
footprint.evidence_status: Source-backed approximate footprint. The ArcGIS Shape__Area field agrees with the ring after reprojection to the layer CRS EPSG:3857; ground-approximate local coordinates yield a smaller CRS-dependent area.

vertical_and_architecture.level_count_source: Purdue GIS NUM_LEVELS and CountOfFLO both report 5; semantics are not documented.
vertical_and_architecture.height_method: R=46.6 is treated as likely feet (46.6 ft = 14.2 m) only as a working estimate; GIS vertical field meaning and unit were not found. Raised entrance gable is an additional visual estimate based on the photo.
vertical_and_architecture.roof: Flat massing roof with a compact raised gabled entrance feature; only the entrance gable is photo-supported. The full roof silhouette is unverified.
vertical_and_architecture.facade: Photo-supported red-brown brick, repeated dark window openings, pale entrance trim/canopy, and recessed front door. Bay spacing and side facade treatment are estimated.
remaining_uncertainty: GIS does not provide documented height units or a reliable story-height schedule.
The exterior reference has no publication date or calibrated dimensions.
Roof shape outside the entrance gable and exact facade rhythm are unverified.
The layer Shape__Area is a projected EPSG:3857 area, while the mesh plan area uses the approximate local ground transform; their numeric difference reflects CRS scale, not disagreement.

geometry_edits: Replaced the original single rectangular massing box with the GIS FID 250 polygon extruded vertically.
Added photo-supported brick facade color, repeated dark window bays, recessed entrance, pale canopy/portico, and compact raised entrance gable.
Kept the manifest object, collection, scene, campus-coordinate frame, object identity transforms, and one-object export stable.

validation.portable_dependencies: No external textures or linked libraries; simple generated materials only.
